seo.title: Redis GUI for {macDevices}
seo.description: Browse Redis keys as a tree split on colons, edit names, TTLs and string values, and run commands with redis-cli quoting on Standalone, Sentinel, Cluster.

header.title: Redis GUI
header.lead: On Mac, browse keys and run commands on Standalone, Sentinel or Cluster deployments. iPhone and iPad support Standalone commands only.

sections.title: Connect
paragraphs: Choose <ui>Connection Mode</ui>: Standalone, Sentinel or Cluster. Sentinel follows the primary after failover; Cluster discovers shards from a seed member and routes commands to the owning shard.

Sign in with a password, or fill in Username to sign in as a Redis 6 ACL user. On Amazon ElastiCache, choose an <cloudAuth>AWS IAM</cloudAuth> mode and a short-lived token becomes the password; ElastiCache IAM needs TLS turned on.

New connections start with TLS off. Upstash, Redis Cloud and similar services require it, and a pasted rediss:// URL turns it on. There is no fallback to plain text, so Preferred behaves as Required. Valkey servers connect the same way as Redis.
The sidebar lists each numbered database from db0 up, and clicking one browses it in place.

sections.title: Keys and commands
paragraphs: Browse keys by colon-separated folders, or choose another separator. Each row shows the key’s type, TTL, length and value. Collections show their first entries; non-UTF-8 values open in the hex editor.
Edit key names, TTLs and string values in the grid. Add Row creates hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets or strings. Filter key names and types using server-side SCAN MATCH and SCAN TYPE.
Run commands with redis-cli-style quoting. Unknown commands are sent as written. DB 3 GET key targets another database without changing the session. In MULTI, replies stay queued until EXEC.

Safe Mode counts every Redis command as a write, GET included, so the Alert and Safe Mode levels confirm each one and Read-Only blocks them all. FLUSHDB and FLUSHALL ask before they run, even at Silent.

sections.title: Move data
paragraphs: <export>Export</export> keys or command results as {exportFormats}. Import is not available for Redis; load data with commands in the editor.

sections.title: iPhone and iPad
paragraphs: On iPhone and iPad, run Redis commands in the Query tab; browsing keys is not available in the iPhone and iPad app. A connection there takes a password, TLS with a CA or client certificate from a file, pasted text or a PKCS#12 bundle, and an SSH tunnel that signs in with a password or a key. Sentinel and Cluster connections are Mac only.

items.text: Choose Redis Insight for its key browser, command Workbench, a Pub/Sub workspace, profiler, slow logs and memory analysis. TablePro works with Redis alongside SQL databases.

notes.redis-insight-copilot: Redis Insight’s Redis Copilot answers Redis questions and builds search queries from plain language.

faq.question: Why is the key tree empty for my ACL user?
faq.answer: The key tree reads key names with SCAN and their types with TYPE. Grant both, for example ACL SETUSER app +scan +type, then right-click Keys in the sidebar and choose Refresh.

faq.question: Why does SELECT not change the sidebar?
faq.answer: SELECT moves only the editor’s session, so the commands after it run on that database while the sidebar and the key tree stay where you clicked. Click a database in the sidebar to move both, or prefix one command with DB and the database number.

faq.question: Why does a managed Redis service list databases it does not have?
faq.answer: Services such as Upstash, Redis Cloud and ElastiCache refuse CONFIG, so TablePro cannot read how many databases they hold and lists a default range. On a service with one database, the databases other than db0 show the server’s error when you open them.
